patch_description: This ansatz removes the redundant collective RZ layer, reducing the model from two to one circuit parameter per repeated block. The resulting model has only 8 total trainable parameters instead of 14 while retaining the collective RY mixing and fixed CZ chain that previously achieved perfect train, validation, and test accuracy with zero generalization gap. It also previously converged faster (60 rather than 90 steps), uses fewer gates, and improves parameter efficiency from approximately 0.07 to 0.12.
